name: io.github.estcarisimo/smoking-pi
title: Smoking Pi
description: Answers questions about a Smoking Pi network monitor from its recorded history.

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: Reach the Smoking Pi config API and InfluxDB on the host's loopback. The server reads a stack that is already running; it does not start one.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Speak stdio. The image default is HTTP, which is how the Smoking Pi stack runs it; a registry client overrides that.

environmentVariables.name: CONFIG_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: config-manager base URL. 127.0.0.1 is the host's loopback when the container uses the host network.

environmentVariables.name: CONFIG_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the config API. Omit only when that API has no token.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_URL
environmentVariables.description: InfluxDB 2.x URL. 127.0.0.1 is the host's loopback when the container uses the host network.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: InfluxDB API token for the smokeping bucket.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_BUCKET
environmentVariables.description: InfluxDB bucket that holds the latency and loss history.
